subject: BioForge technical preview — vendor intake and NDA gating
messages:
From: Cara Taylor <cara.taylor@bioforge.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@bioforge.com
Date: Mon, 10 Jul 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request to schedule a technical preview — procurement prerequisites

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the call last week — we appreciated the product overview. Our team would like to schedule a technical preview (30–45 min) with engineering next week to evaluate latency characteristics and integration options.

Before we can confirm a slot our procurement/security team requires: a signed NDA on file and completion of our vendor security questionnaire (portal-based). I copied procurement on this thread so they can share the portal link and any required evidence (SOC 2, attestations, SSO configuration notes).

Preferable demo window: July 12–15. Do you have availability then?

Thanks,
Cara Taylor
Head of Integrations
BioForge Therapeutics

--
Attachment: (none yet)
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: Cara Taylor <cara.taylor@bioforge.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 Jul 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to schedule a technical preview — procurement prerequisites

Hi Cara — thanks for the note and for looping procurement in.

We can absolutely do a 30–45 minute technical preview. I attached a signed copy of our mutual NDA to this reply (Signed_NDA_BioForge_20280710.pdf) to get that box checked.

A couple of logistics so we can move fast:
- Can procurement send the vendor portal URL and the questionnaire id so we can upload our SOC 2 report and any evidence?
- Our CTO (Alex Rivera) is traveling July 12–13 and will want to join the preview for the performance portion. If that timing is firm on your side, we can do a tech-focused session without him; otherwise we prefer to shift to a date the week of July 18 so Alex can attend.
- Looping in Lauren (solutions) for a pre-demo run and Stephanie (legal/sales ops) for contracting questions. Priyom (cc’ed on later emails) will own the integration test after the portal steps complete.

Proposed alternative slots (week of Jul 18):
- Tue Jul 19, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed Jul 20, 13:00–13:45 PT
- Thu Jul 21, 09:00–09:45 PT

If procurement can expedite the portal invite and accepts the attached NDA, we’ll prioritize the earlier dates.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Attachment: Signed_NDA_BioForge_20280710.pdf
From: BioForge Procurement <procurement@bioforge.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai; Cara Taylor <cara.taylor@bioforge.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 10:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to schedule a technical preview — procurement prerequisites

Hi Marcus / Cara,

Thanks — attaching the vendor portal link below. Please complete the questionnaire and upload any evidence (SOC 2 report or self-attestation, encryption and key management summary, and data retention policy). We will not allow full access to internal demo environments until the portal intake is complete and a basic SSO test is scheduled.

Portal: https://portal.bioforge.com/vendor-onboarding/DF-4782
Questionnaire ID: BF-SEC-2028-07

A couple notes: if you can provide the SOC 2 or a signed self-attestation and confirm your SSO provider (Okta, Azure AD, or other), we can fast-track. Otherwise, the earliest we would provision demo access is July 19, assuming intake is completed by July 17.

Also — we require the NDA on file; appreciate you sending that. Once intake is complete, we’ll propose two demo windows for the engineers.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Senior Procurement Manager
BioForge Therapeutics
procurement@bioforge.com

Attachment: BioForge_Vendor_Portal_Instructions.pdf (see portal link)
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: Cara Taylor <cara.taylor@bioforge.com>, procurement@bioforge.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 14 Jul 2028 17:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to schedule a technical preview — procurement prerequisites

Great — thanks for the portal link, Alex. We completed the BF-SEC-2028-07 questionnaire and uploaded the following artifacts to the portal this morning:
- SOC 2 Type II (summary + report)
- Encryption & key management note (HSM/KMS details)
- Data handling and retention policy excerpt

I also re-attached the signed NDA here for your records (Signed_NDA_BioForge_20280710.pdf). Priyom will run the SSO test with your identity team — Priyom, can you coordinate with Alex to schedule a short SSO check the week of Jul 17? If that completes, we’re happy to confirm Tue Jul 19, 10:00 PT for the technical preview (Alex will be back in time and available).

If procurement can provision a test user and a short demo token-permissions role after intake, we’ll limit the demo to the performance/integration surface and keep it to 35 minutes.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the session.

Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142
